info.title: Inaya Network Public API
info.description: Every public/v1 request needs Authorization: Bearer <api key>. An org owner/admin issues a key from the Business Workspace's API Keys settings (src/app/api/orgs/api-keys/route.js), or Terraform can be pointed at one via INAYA_API_KEY. The key resolves to exactly one organization server-side (requireApiKey() in src/lib/api-keys.js) -- no request body or query parameter can ever point it at a different org.

bearerAuth.description: An Inaya org API key. See /docs/api.

get.summary: Fetch the evidence trail for one business record.

parameters.name: recordType
parameters.description: The record's type, e.g. INVOICE, PURCHASE_ORDER.

200.description: The record's evidence trail (getEvidenceTrail()) -- the same tamper-evident audit chain data the Business Workspace's own Audit Trail view reads.

403.description: The API key's organization does not have access to this capability.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist, or does not belong to this API key's organization.

get.summary: Verify the calling organization's full audit-chain integrity.

200.description: A pass/fail integrity result over the org's entire audit chain (verifyOrgEvidenceIntegrity()).

403.description: The API key's organization does not have access to this capability.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist, or does not belong to this API key's organization.

get.summary: Check whether a named permission gate is enabled for the calling organization.

parameters.name: gate
parameters.description: One of 17 gate names, e.g. canManageFinance, canAccessAudit, canManageGovernment -- see orgGates.js for the full list.

200.description: { gate, allowed }. Note: an API key always resolves a synthetic owner-level membership, so this checks that a capability exists and is enabled for the org, not a specific human's individual role.

403.description: The API key's organization does not have access to this capability.

404.description: The requested resource does not exist, or does not belong to this API key's organization.
